[Trooper Class Transfer]:
In order to become a Berserker, you must successfully complete a quest, Certified Berserker, which may be undertaken at level 39. To embark on it, visit Master Orkurus of Oren Castle Town.
[The Class Master]:
Rather than the quest, from level 40 you may visit the Class Master in Giran, next to the Arena. Clear his short trial, alone in a private hall, and he grants your new class at once.
